seoTitle: AI & Software Solutions for Cross-industry | Fruition
seoDescription: 12 cross-industry use cases on monday.com, 0 with AI. See the process, boards, automations and integrations for each.
heading: Cross-industry use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do cross-industry organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 12 cross-industry use cases. The most common are work & project management (9), integrations & migration (8), operations & ERP (8), most often for operations & delivery, sales & CRM, finance & procurement teams.

faq.question: Which systems do cross-industry builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in cross-industry use cases are Make, Xero, Outlook, DocuSign, Google Drive, Gravity Forms.

useCases.title: Live events infrastructure company
useCases.summary: Around 150 projects were tracked with individual Excel RAID logs, and budgets, purchase orders and actuals had to be pulled manually from finance for each event.
useCases.challenge: Around 150 projects were tracked with individual Excel RAID logs, and budgets, purchase orders and actuals had to be pulled manually from finance for each event.
boards: Portfolio board for ~150 active projects with connected forms
Consolidated RAID log replacing per-project Excel files, with PM permissions
Standard phase-based project plan template
Forms: project notification, change request, customer satisfaction, lessons learned, site visits and sign-offs
Archival workspace
Purchase orders board by cost category linked to portfolio
Finance dashboard: baseline budget vs forecast (POs) vs actual (P&L) per project
automations: Job reference number automation
Change request form → automation
Connected-column updates → workflows populate portfolio
Xero purchase orders synced per project by cost-category code
Xero per-project P&L actuals synced with link back to source

process.title: Event project portfolio with RAID, change control and Xero actuals

steps.label: Log risks in consolidated RAID log
Xero POs synced by cost code
Xero P&L actuals synced per project
Budget vs forecast vs actual dashboard

useCases.title: Diversified group of companies with a central strategic projects office
useCases.summary: All project planning and tracking ran on disconnected spreadsheets and documents, with no portfolio view, no standard methodology and manual status reporting for leadership.
useCases.challenge: All project planning and tracking ran on disconnected spreadsheets and documents, with no portfolio view, no standard methodology and manual status reporting for leadership.
boards: Project intake form: standardised requests (priority, budget, type, timeline)
Portfolio board: all active/upcoming/completed projects with drill-down
Project templates (large/small) with initiation, planning, execution, closure phases
Gantt with dependencies, baselines and critical path
Risk register with probability/impact scoring linked to projects
Portfolio and project dashboards with scheduled PDF reports
automations: Budget/type threshold → approval routing to senior approver
Approval → project board auto-generated from template
Predecessor date shift → dependency notifications
useCases.outcome: Make the platform the projects office command centre with standard intake and approvals, templated execution, risk register and automated portfolio reporting, as a base for group-wide rollout.

process.title: Project intake, approval and portfolio reporting

useCases.title: Exterior cleaning services business
useCases.summary: Quoting, jobs and calendars ran across disconnected systems with poor mobile use, causing double data entry, manual status updates and confusing scheduling.
useCases.challenge: Quoting, jobs and calendars ran across disconnected systems with poor mobile use, causing double data entry, manual status updates and confusing scheduling.
boards: Restructured job board with status workflows and map/location view
Mobile job intake and lead capture forms with address fields
Quote status tracking with sales dashboard
Consolidated task view with categories, priorities and owners
Optional: time tracking per job with productivity dashboards
automations: Job scheduling → Outlook calendar sync
Quote status sync between monday and existing quoting/job tool (bi-directional via Zapier)
Quote follow-up notifications
Optional phase: quote/invoice automation and payment tracking via Xero
useCases.outcome: A 15-hour phase cleaning up the job CRM, adding mobile forms and calendar sync, then a 10-hour phase integrating the quoting tool and consolidating tasks.

process.title: Mobile enquiry to scheduled job with synced quoting

useCases.title: Fresh produce grower and exporter
useCases.summary: Sales were in monday.com but orders, shipping bookings, invoicing and documents were re-keyed across separate systems, limiting visibility between departments.
useCases.challenge: Sales were in monday.com but orders, shipping bookings, invoicing and documents were re-keyed across separate systems, limiting visibility between departments.
boards: Customer database and sales activities with follow-up on lapsed customers
Order management with form-based order capture and dispatch-date views for daily pack lists
Inventory tracking with reorder-point alerts
Harvest planning
QC log at stock intake for export inspection compliance
Sales, order and stock dashboards; mobile access for packing staff
automations: Order status change → email Excel export to packing house
Stock below threshold → alert
No recent order → sales follow-up reminder
useCases.outcome: A 20-hour first phase for order tracking, inventory and reporting dashboards, with ERP/API integration assessed for later phases.

process.title: Order capture to dispatch with stock and invoicing

useCases.title: Multi-region fitness franchise network
useCases.summary: Operational data was split across regional monday.com accounts on different products and data centres, with workflows needing optimisation before consolidation and limited central reporting for leadership.
useCases.challenge: Operational data was split across regional monday.com accounts on different products and data centres, with workflows needing optimisation before consolidation and limited central reporting for leadership.
boards: Account migration: ~40 boards and templates moved from a Work Management account to a CRM account in another region
Franchise onboarding and pipeline boards: optimised during migration
Event management and social media planning workflows
Board consolidation: replace separate boards with views
Multi-area reporting dashboards including an executive dashboard
Global user and permission configuration across the franchise network
automations: Post-migration custom automations
Contract population from board columns and document status tracking via e-signature tool
useCases.outcome: Migrate and consolidate around 40 boards into a single CRM account, simplify workflows, connect ticketing, events and contract tools, and give leadership cross-area dashboards.

process.title: Franchise pipeline with contracts and leadership reporting

useCases.title: Community services not-for-profit (state peak body)
useCases.summary: A not-for-profit lacked visibility of project status, task ownership and staff workload, and tracked member interactions and requests informally.
useCases.challenge: A not-for-profit lacked visibility of project status, task ownership and staff workload, and tracked member interactions and requests informally.
boards: Project management with task ownership, timelines and Gantt views
Workload and capacity views incl. time tracking for activities such as dietitian reviews
Member CRM with interaction and activity tracking
Intake and approval forms for member requests
Executive dashboards
automations: Form submission → approval routing, assignment and reminders
Outlook email logging to member records
useCases.outcome: A six-week first phase delivering project and workload visibility, a member CRM, request forms with approval routing and executive dashboards, with donor/volunteer CRM and finance integration as later phases.

process.title: Member requests to tracked project and workload visibility

useCases.title: Global energy services company (procurement operations team)
useCases.summary: A multinational procurement team lacked visibility across boards and of team capacity, had automations broken by account ownership changes, and was part-way through moving off another task tool.
useCases.challenge: A multinational procurement team lacked visibility across boards and of team capacity, had automations broken by account ownership changes, and was part-way through moving off another task tool.
boards: Energy procurement workflow boards (tender → completed → monitoring)
Operations dashboard consolidating boards for status, workload and capacity
Templates for side projects and IT-oriented tenders
Migration of tasks and comments from a previous task tool
automations: Item moved to monitoring stage → temporary sub-items removed (Make.com)
New task → due date set for capacity planning
API scripting support for repetitive tasks
useCases.outcome: A ~15-hour support engagement covering an operations dashboard, sub-item automation, task migration, API help and training.

process.title: Procurement tender workflow with automated clean-up and capacity

useCases.title: Independent music artist management company
useCases.summary: Campaign work and approvals were handled through texts and emails, so approvals and final assets got lost and finding outstanding tasks took hours.
useCases.challenge: Campaign work and approvals were handled through texts and emails, so approvals and final assets got lost and finding outstanding tasks took hours.
boards: Project delivery board that builds campaign steps from templates by campaign type (release, tour, campaign)
Centralised approvals for creative assets, merch and music
Gantt and calendar views of campaign progress
Import of internal spreadsheets; shareable outstanding-task exports for external consultants
Optional future: portfolio view with budget tracking
automations: Project type selected → generate templated task list
Approval status changes → notify owners
useCases.outcome: A 20-hour build (plus optional 10 hours of training and hypercare) of templated campaign workflows with centralised approvals.

process.title: Templated campaigns with centralised creative approvals

useCases.title: National home cleaning services company
useCases.summary: A national cleaning business with a large contractor network faced escalating per-feature CRM costs, poor data quality with many duplicate contacts and fragile integrations to its booking system.
useCases.challenge: A national cleaning business with a large contractor network faced escalating per-feature CRM costs, poor data quality with many duplicate contacts and fragile integrations to its booking system.
boards: Centralised omnichannel service inbox (email, phone, messaging, web forms, chatbot) with ticket boards
Contact management with built-in de-duplication
Lead pipeline, client onboarding and email sequences / mass email
Internal knowledge base
Service, sales and CSAT dashboards
automations: Ticket routed automatically by enquiry type
Status change → workflow triggers, notifications and follow-up reminders
useCases.outcome: Replace the incumbent CRM and helpdesk with combined service and CRM modules, migrate and de-duplicate tens of thousands of contacts and connect the booking platform.

process.title: Omnichannel service and sales with booking platform sync

useCases.title: Fuel-system compliance and testing contractor
useCases.summary: Leads, site visits and multi-test compliance quotes were handled manually, making proposals slow and pricing inconsistent across service types and regions.
useCases.challenge: Leads, site visits and multi-test compliance quotes were handled manually, making proposals slow and pricing inconsistent across service types and regions.
boards: Lead intake board for website and marketing-campaign leads with qualification stages
Sales pipeline (discovery, site visit, proposal, negotiation, won/lost) with site-visit tracking and photo/video attachments
Menu-driven proposal board: system type, tank/pipe configuration and test types drive line-item pricing
Zip-code-to-region mapping board for regional upcharges
Document management with e-signature and delivery tracking
automations: New lead → auto-assignment and notification (including team chat channel)
Service selections → automated PDF proposal generated from a document template via Make, with region-based pricing
Proposal sent → e-signature envelope and configurable follow-up reminders

process.title: Compliance lead to region-priced proposal and e-signature

useCases.title: Multi-site holiday park operator
useCases.summary: Departments worked in siloed, task-only workspaces; manager onboarding touchpoints and monthly compliance checks across many parks were tracked manually with no systematic view of overdue items.
useCases.challenge: Departments worked in siloed, task-only workspaces; manager onboarding touchpoints and monthly compliance checks across many parks were tracked manually with no systematic view of overdue items.
boards: Manager onboarding workflow: form captures new manager details and creates a 6-month touchpoint plan by manager type
Head-office touchpoint assignments for HR contracts and training
Monthly compliance task tracker across all parks with overdue tracking
automations: Onboarding form submitted → scheduled touchpoint tasks assigned to head-office staff
Monthly recurring compliance tasks created per park; overdue → flagged
integrations: External forms app for non-licensed park staff
useCases.outcome: A 20-hour package automating manager onboarding touchpoints and monthly multi-site compliance tracking using native features.

process.title: Automated manager onboarding and multi-site compliance tracking
